Name: Panning Without Pan
Author: kumagabear
Description:
Panning rewards are actually pretty good… but are they good enough to sacrifice [b]one inventory slot[/b]?[b] NO[/b]! I can use that free slot for hoarding more trash

“But you can wear the Pan as a hat!”
[b]NOOO!!![/b] Have you seen how ridiculous that looks? I don't want to go outside look like that

This mod lets you pan ore without carrying the copper pan

It automatically uses your real Copper Pan data upgrade level and enchantments, even if the pan is in a chest.
The mod checks your pan each night, but if you upgrade your pan during the day,[b] just use it once and the mod will update the data immediately[/b].

GMCM Config:
- Enable/disable daily inventory/chest scanning - if you only want to manually update the copper data 
- Toggle animation (full panning animation or instant pan)
- Adjust panning radius

ps: Haven't tested the enchantments, let me know if there are any error
